title: Show honest empty and error states in the marketplace
prompt:
Fix only src/app/marketplace/page.tsx and add tests/marketplace-catalog-state.test.mjs. Evidence: src/app/marketplace/page.tsx:168-270 defines fictional seed tools with provider badges and usage counts. Line 273 initializes the marketplace with them; lines 283-290 substitute them for an empty catalog or a failed fetch. A local execution with a successful {tools:[]} response left ten fictional tools in state after loading finished. The aggregate metrics at lines 309-313 also count those fixtures. Users can select integration examples for tools that the catalog never returned.

Initialize with an empty tool list, remove the seed fallback, and distinguish loading, successful empty, successful populated, and failed catalog requests. Check response.ok and validate the tools array before accepting it. Render a clear empty-catalog message for zero tools and a clear fetch-error message on failure; neither state should claim fictional availability or usage. Preserve filtering and cards for real results. Do not add pagination or alter other catalog consumers.

Add behavioral node:test coverage for empty success, populated success, HTTP failure, invalid payload, and rejected fetch. Use in-memory TypeScript transpilation and React hook/JSX stubs to exercise state transitions and resulting messages; no network access or new dependencies. Run node --test tests/marketplace-catalog-state.test.mjs. Do not touch credentials, auth, payments, sends, deploys, migrations, workflows, or package.json. Do not commit or push; work on the assigned branch you are on.
